_comment: Agent alias → session UUID mapping. Used by scripts/last-message.py via `just last <alias>`. UUIDs are session IDs from your AI tool's session storage (Claude Code: ~/.claude/projects/<project-slug>/<uuid>.jsonl). Run `just discover-sessions` to list recent JSONLs and find UUIDs for new aliases.

_storage._comment: Optional override for non-Claude-Code tools. Default is Claude Code's ~/.claude/projects/<project-slug>/.

aliases._comment_aliases: Examples — replace with your project's agents. Each alias maps to {uuid, role}. The 'role' string is informational, shown by `just aliases` to help humans and other agents understand who-is-who.

_example_human.role: Example — replace with a real session UUID for the human-facing primary agent
